checks.name: prd_grill_binds_source_and_defers_dependent_questions
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.prd_grill import grill_prd, verify_prd_grill
with TemporaryDirectory() as value:
    root = Path(value)
    source = root / 'PRD.md'
    original = '# Draft\n\nA useful idea without a product contract.\n'
    source.write_text(original, encoding='utf-8')
    result = grill_prd(source, root, mode='quick')
    assert source.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == original
    assert [item['id'] for item in result['questions']] == ['Q-REQUIREMENTS', 'Q-ACTORS', 'Q-OUTCOMES']
    assert {item['id']: item['deferred_by'] for item in result['deferred_questions']}['Q-ACCEPTANCE'] == ['Q-REQUIREMENTS']
    assert result['authority'] == {'implementation': 'not_authorized', 'external_effects': 'not_authorized'}
    assert verify_prd_grill(Path(result['path']))['valid'] is True

checks.name: prd_grill_confirmation_requires_a_complete_contract
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.product_missions import ProductMissionError
from factoryline.prd_grill import grill_prd
with TemporaryDirectory() as value:
    root = Path(value)
    source = root / 'PRD.md'
    source.write_text('# Draft\n', encoding='utf-8')
    try:
        grill_prd(source, root, confirm=True)
    except ProductMissionError as error:
        assert error.code == 'PRD_GRILL_UNRESOLVED'
    else:
        raise AssertionError('confirmation unexpectedly bypassed unresolved questions')
